PURSUANT TO 49 USC 40103(B)(3), THE FEDERAL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION (FAA) CLASSIFIES THE AIRSPACE DEFINED IN THIS NOTAM AS 'NTL DEFENSE AIRSPACE'. PILOTS WHO DO NOT ADHERE TO THE FOLLOWING PROC MAY BE INTERCEPTED, DETAINED AND INTERVIEWED BY LAW ENFORCEMENT/SECURITY PERSONNEL. ANY OF THE FOLLOWING ADDITIONAL ACTIONS MAY ALSO BE TAKEN AGAINST A PILOT WHO DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE RQMNTS OR ANY SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS OR PROC ANNOUNCED IN THIS NOTAM: A) THE FAA MAY TAKE ADMINISTRATIVE ACTION, INCLUDING IMPOSING CIVIL PENALTIES AND THE SUSPENSION OR REVOCATION OF AIRMEN CERTIFICATES; OR B) THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT MAY PURSUE CRIMINAL CHARGES, INCLUDING CHARGES UNDER 49 USC SECTION 46307; OR C) THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT MAY USE DEADLY FORCE AGAINST THE AIRBORNE ACFT, IF IT IS DETERMINED THAT THE ACFT POSES AN IMMINENT SECURITY THREAT. PURSUANT TO 14 CFR 99.7, SPECIAL SECURITY INSTRUCTIONS (SSI), ALL UNMANNED ACFT SYSTEM - UAS FLT OPS ARE PROHIBITED: WI 1NM INLAND FROM THE U.S. SIDE OF THE U.S./MEXICO BORDER PORTION FM ANY POINT ALONG A LINE STARTING AT 294543N1023336W (FST152074.4) ENDING AT 255737N0970833W (BRO071012.8) EXCLUDING MEXICAN AIRSPACE SFC-400FT AGL EFFECTIVE 2610200000 UTC UNTIL 2710192359 UTC. SEE DOMESTIC NOTICE HTTPS://WWW.FAA.GOV/AIR_TRAFFIC/PUBLICATIONS/DOMESTICNOTICES/ OR VISUALIZE IT FOR GRAPHICAL REPRESENTATION EXC AS SPECIFIED BLW: A. UAS OPS MAY BE AUTH WI THE DEFINED AIRSPACE PROVIDED PRIOR APPROVAL HAS BEEN COORD WITH U.S. CUSTOMS AND BORDER PROTECTION (CBP), AND ALL APPLICABLE RQMNTS LISTED BLW ARE MET: 1. UAS OPS IN DCT SUPPORT OF ACT NTL DEFENSE, HOMELAND SECURITY, LAW ENFORCEMENT, FIREFIGHTING, MEDEVAC, SAR, OR DISASTER RESPONSE MISSIONS; 2. UAS OPS IN SUPPORT OF EVENT OPS; 3. UAS OPS MUST HAVE RECEIVED PRIOR COORD AND APPROVAL THROUGH CBP 4. AND UAS OPS MUST COMPLY WITH ALL OTHER APPLICABLE FEDERAL AVIATION REGULATIONS. B. UAS OPR WHO DO NOT COMPLY WITH APPLICABLE AIRSPACE RESTRICTIONS ARE WARNED THAT PURSUANT TO 10 U.S.C. SECTION 130I AND 6 U.S.C. SECTION 124N, THE DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE(DOD), THE DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY(DHS) OR THE DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE(DOJ) MAY TAKE SECURITY ACTION THAT RESULTS IN THE INTERFERENCE, DISRUPTION, SEIZURE, DAMAGING, OR DESTRUCTION OF UNMANNED ACFT DEEMED TO POSE A CREDIBLE SAFETY OR SECURITY THREAT TO PROTECTED PERSONNEL, FAC, OR ASSETS. C. U.S. CUSTOMS AND BORDER PROTECTION (CBP) IS RESPONSIBLE FOR MANAGING UAS AIRSPACE ACCESS REQUESTS WI THE DEFINED SSI AIRSPACE. UAS OPR REQUESTING ACCESS MUST SUBMIT REQUESTS TO SWBDRONEZONEWAIVERS@CBP.DHS.GOV AT LEAST 48 HOURS PRIOR TO OPS. ALL REQUESTS MUST INCLUDE: 1) OPERATOR NAME 2) FAA CERTIFICATIONS 3) OPERATOR TELEPHONE NUMBER 4) FLIGHT DATE, TIME AND LOCATION 5) UAS INFORMATION: REMOTE ID, MAKE, MODEL AND SERIAL NUMBER. D. FIRST RESPONDERS EMERGENCY UAS OPS CTC CBP AT 951-570-4185. E. THE FAA RECOMMENDS THAT ALL ACFT OPR CK NOTAMS FREQUENTLY FOR POSSIBLE CHANGES TO THIS TFR PRIOR TO OPS. OPR MAY REVIEW THE TFR DETAILS AT HTTPS://TFR.FAA.GOV/ OR HTTPS://WWW.1800WXBRIEF.COM. 2610200000-2710192359
